title: Stephan's Quintet (JWST)
explanation: JWST's first-light image of Stephan's Quintet — four of five galaxies locked in a cosmic dance 290 million light-years away.

title: Hubble Ultra Deep Field
explanation: Roughly 10,000 galaxies — some only 500 million years after the Big Bang — crowd this tiny patch of sky.

title: SMACS 0723 — Webb's First Deep Field
explanation: The first JWST deep field: galaxy cluster SMACS 0723 with thousands of lensed background galaxies.

title: Pandora's Cluster (JWST)
explanation: Webb reveals Pandora's Cluster — three merging galaxy clusters whose combined gravity lenses distant background galaxies into brilliant arcs.

title: Andromeda Galaxy (Hubble)
credit: NASA, ESA, J. Dalcanton et al.
explanation: The Andromeda Galaxy — the Milky Way's nearest large neighbour, 2.5 million light-years away.
